customMemoryTypes.name: coding_preference
customMemoryTypes.description: A preference the user has stated about how they want code written: style, docstrings, naming, testing or tooling.

fields.name: topic
fields.description: What the preference is about, for example docstrings, naming, testing or tooling.

extractionStrategy.prompt: Extract a coding_preference only from what the user says, in their own words, about how they want code written or which conventions and tools they want used, for example "I like Google-style docstrings" or "use pytest, not unittest". Use only the user's messages. Never infer a preference from code or text the assistant wrote. If the new messages contain nothing the user said about how they want code written, extract nothing. When the user changes a preference, update the existing memory instead of adding a second one. Ignore tasks the user asked for. Write each preference as one short sentence, for example "Prefers Google-style docstrings."
